facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple strike and the watch reading of twenty minutes to nine, plus the uncle's scene in front of everyone.
Transcript has him go up to the library, stay there alone, and read twenty to ten by his watch when the temple struck ten.
Transcript gives the thump above him in the atelier at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
Transcript gives someone going quickly up past the library door at a quarter past ten, and someone coming quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten, both by his watch, neither seen, door shut.
Transcript says his aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.

The sheet has Bastien Girard entering the library at 10:32 by his watch. The transcript gives the 10:32 entry by watch and the sitting together until eleven, but the person is an unnamed 'he' who is not in a good humour and talks about money owed, which reads as the uncle. Girard is not named in that passage at all, so the person differs.

added.quote: He came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by my watch.
added.why: The uncle, not Girard, is placed moving into the library at 10:32, so the uncle was away from the atelier above at that time, about fourteen minutes after the thump and repeater began.
